study.question: Can separating the pooled-history and signed-detail families before their task-specific tanh projection improve click AUC over the incumbent without more learned parameters, and does any advantage depend on semantic grouping and auxiliary context transfer?
study.hypothesis: Observed: source inspection shows h=tanh(W*[base,log match counts,five contrast summaries]), so all history families share a saturating nonlinearity. Earlier ordered block/moment and match-detail trajectories improved their immediate parents; initial compressed task queries failed, and signed context/history products later outperformed sums (0.6684573079 versus0.6645631512). Added target factors in round47 did not beat the incumbent (triple0.6684064171, additive0.6671719299, history-pair0.6682834787); exact parent replay matched0.6684573079. Provisional mechanism: separately bounding pooled evidence and contrast evidence may avoid cancellation or one family saturating the other before context modulation. Saturation/interference is NOT measured. Predictive benefit and semantic specificity remain hypotheses. Auxiliary context-transfer interaction is tested rather than assumed.

nearest_work.difference: Archived v4 section4.3 lines250-277 inspected. Inherits target-conditioned unnormalized local activation, implemented on the fixed compressed inputs. Separating two downstream projection families is a local extension; neither target-conditioned pooling nor preserving interest intensity is new.

Exact available parent source SHA256 a2fe811c7ef287b2028ec5b5844ce47c40847af521e6d4e7dffd63834e2ed380. Keep every learned matrix; replace tanh(Wx) by (tanh(W_A*x_A)+tanh(W_B*x_B))/sqrt2 before the same signed query product and RMS. No new target factor.

Pinned benchmark forward lines175-200 read alongside benchmark section2.3. UniMixer flattens the event sequence with context and tokenizes it for interaction blocks. This experiment keeps the parent compressed summaries and separates two column families of one task-specific projection, with no new tokenizer or interaction stack. This is a benchmark-code comparison, not an original-method equivalence claim.

Section2.3 describes OneTrans repeated mixed attention, HyFormer sequence/query updates, Zenith dedicated ID/attribute tokens, and UniMixer chunk tokens. None is reproduced here. Original OneTrans/HyFormer/UniMixer detailed text is unavailable through the authorized registry. Scientific priority and exhaustive nearest-work coverage remain unverified.

inherited_components: All frozen input, label, scoring and training contracts.

The entire g0-r0039-context_product architecture and initialized learned modules: embedding tables, folded compression and scorer, moment summaries, residual bank, rank16 task-specific projections and output matrices, native Dice populations and task towers.
The existing auxiliary adapter-context gate; item/action/scorer gradients remain blocked for auxiliary tasks and tower-context gradients remain blocked.
study.proposed_difference: Partition the inherited history-projection columns into complementary sets A and B, each used once with its original weights. Semantic A is the first value_width columns (base pooled history); B is log match counts plus five signed detail summaries. Arbitrary A consists of floor(k*history_width/value_width) for k=0..value_width-1; B is its sorted complement. Both A groups have identical size. Compute two bias-free indexed linear projections in host precision, cast their results to FP32, then h=(tanh(z_A)+tanh(z_B))/sqrt2. Continue with the inherited bounded context query, q*h, RMS normalization and zero-initialized output projection. Four cells cross semantic/interleaved grouping with enabled/blocked auxiliary adapter-context transfer. Parameter count, module order, RNG and all learned initialization remain unchanged; only deterministic nonpersistent column-index buffers are added. Initial predictions match the parent because output projections are zero, not because the new h equals the parent. Existing accepted joint-tanh enabled/blocked trials supply the third grouping level, forming a six-cell conceptual comparison without charging redundant replays.
predictions: Primary semantic prediction: semantic_transfer exceeds both interleaved_transfer and g0-r0039-context_product on full-population click AUC; the source benchmarks0.6606469405 and0.6601633627 remain reference thresholds, not the strongest comparator.
If separation helps generically but semantic_transfer is no better than interleaved_transfer, support only a nonlinear reparameterization effect; reject semantic-family attribution.

Transfer interaction is delta_semantic=AUC(semantic_transfer)-AUC(semantic_blocked) versus delta_interleaved and the historical joint-tanh delta0.0006024358324034. No sign or significance is assumed. Compare corresponding blocked cells to g0-r0039-context_product_blocked.

No additional learned parameters: expected total32192421, embedding31793216, dense399205 in every cell. Host feature_map determines widths; expected value112/history675 are inferred from prior counts, not independently measured.

If feasible under authorized diagnostics, record training-only aggregate distributions of z_A,z_B,z_A+z_B; saturation fractions abs(z)>2, opposite-sign rates and tanh derivative magnitudes. A performance gain alone does not establish relief of saturation. These diagnostics consume budget and may not change the frozen recipe.
falsifiers: If semantic_transfer fails to exceed incumbent click AUC, reject useful complementarity for this implementation; do not refute history-family separation in general.
If arbitrary partition matches or beats semantic partition, semantic alignment has no controlled support even if both beat joint tanh.
No excess saturation/cancellation or no corresponding derivative difference in authorized diagnostics falsifies the proposed saturation explanation; alternative optimization explanations remain.
If advantages disappear on paired repetitions, or runtime/latency makes the model dominated on measured quality-cost comparisons, do not promote the candidate.

Any data/mask/gradient ownership failure, nonfinite output or checkpoint inconsistency invalidates the implementation before scientific interpretation. Missing tensor execution here is an unavailable prerequisite, not evidence for or against the mechanism.
alternative_explanations: One fixed training seed; deterministic replays are not independent repetitions.
Equal learned parameter count does not equal functional capacity or runtime; two indexed GEMMs replace one and nonlinear geometry changes.
Interleaved partition matches dimensions and parameter use, but not empirical group variance, correlations or effective rank.
The existing auxiliary adapter-context gate affects both the residual and product branches. Transfer contrasts do not isolate product-only gradient mediation.
Extra nonlinear units, different BF16 reduction order, kernel dispatch, index selection, numerical regularization and input-family scaling can explain gains without saturation relief.
Many rounds share one validation day; adaptive validation selection and user dependence limit generalization.
History-length and empty-history slice changes can reflect shared embedding updates rather than a direct history branch effect.

Primary click improvements can coincide with worse auxiliary discrimination: incumbent cart/fav/buy AUC0.8079/0.8192/0.8309 versus DIN0.8491/0.8649/0.8702. Report every task and do not claim general multitask improvement.
